events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Known for his distinctive vocal style and outspoken personality, English singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment or lyric?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and the title track single followed in October 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Does this song still resonate with you today?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod was unveiled. Did you have one, and what was the first song you loaded?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which debuted on October 5, 1962, marking over six decades of 007 on screen.

angles.name: Bond Favourite
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Shaken, not stirred, naturally.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, singer, and songwriter, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical range.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double LP with everything from 'Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da' to 'Helter Skelter'. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away at the age of 45 in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sounds
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and delivered timeless tracks. What's your favourite from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot at the age of 40 in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world.
